# Jumper Cables

How do I start a local llama.cpp server?

Paste one of these on Linux. Replace /path/to/your-model.gguf.
For macOS or Windows, from this repo run: python3 src/jc.py --preset gpu --os mac --model /path/to/your-model.gguf
Repo: https://github.com/CSI-Platform/jumper-cables

## All on GPU

Every layer on the GPU, with the largest context that fits. Usually the fastest.

llama-server \
  -m /path/to/your-model.gguf \
  --n-gpu-layers all \
  --fit on \
  --port 8080

## Long memory

Asks for a 32K context. On a small GPU, some layers may move to the CPU.

llama-server \
  -m /path/to/your-model.gguf \
  --ctx-size 32768 \
  --port 8080

## CPU only

Runs without the GPU. Slower, but works on any machine with enough RAM.

llama-server \
  -m /path/to/your-model.gguf \
  --n-gpu-layers 0 \
  --port 8080

## Read-only tools

The model can search and read files your account can read, including private ones. It can't change anything. Experimental.
Tools are on. They're experimental and can read what your account can read.

llama-server \
  -m /path/to/your-model.gguf \
  --tools read_file,file_glob_search,grep_search,get_info \
  --port 8080

Full option catalog: https://jc.csi.run
